title: Tunisian Chicken and Greens Pilaf
description: A flavorful and healthy pilaf dish made with Tunisian spices, chicken, and nutritious shungiku greens.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced red pepper to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the Tunisian spice blend and cook for another minute.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the cooked chicken and shungiku greens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
